lines.text: Tip a square cover diagonally, and it slips right through its own hole.
A circle is the same width in every direction. So a round cover can never fall in.
But circles aren't special. There are infinitely many shapes with that property, like a curved triangle.
Round just wins because it's easy to make, and a round lid rolls like a wheel.
Microsoft even made this a famous job interview question.
The shortest answer? Manholes are round because manholes are round.
